instructions_to_main_agent: Create component files with .js/.jsx extensions (React app in JS context). Ensure high-quality modular design.
Import fonts: 'Instrument Serif' and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' in public/index.html or index.css.
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling for luxury momentum feeling.
Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs, team cards, pitch form submit) include clear kebab-case `data-testid` attributes.
Use Sonner for toast notification on pitch form submission with validation handling (file size check <= 20MB, required fields).
Keep Orange Tree logo orange (#E85D04) restrained — apply only as an accent badge, button focus state, or kinetic dot accent, never blanket full-page bright orange.
Provide interactive filtering/tabs in Portfolio section (Direct Investments, Fund LPs, Exits, All) with hover sub-sector badges.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Preserve natural reading hierarchy.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or crisp architectural) with micro-interactions.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡 for UI icons. Use Lucide or Phosphor React icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
All key interactive elements MUST include `data-testid` attributes.
